Name: Alex Aiston
Bio:
When I joined my Father in early 2018, it was with a clear vision to build not only my own knowledge but, build a respectable company in the Fire Safety Industry. 

Having now taken over the Managing Director role for AFC Fire, I am really looking forward to taking this company to where it deserves to be. 

I also hold multiple qualifications & accreditations, paired with multiple industry experiences across HRRB’s, theatres, complex buildings, General Needs, Independent/Supported Living & Care Homes. 

My beliefs are in line with my father's i.e. professionalism, trust and reliability, and I also believe that a complete understanding of our customers’ needs is key to the continued success of AFC Fire.

I'm proud to say I have recently been elected to the Council of Institute of Fire Safety Managers 2024.
Accreditation: Warrington Fire - FRACS Individual Scheme,IFSM Member ,IFSM Tier 3 - 2023

Name: Mark Aiston
Bio:
Mark founded AFC Fire in 2014 with a clear vision to provide the best solutions, at the best price, and in the best timeframe to ensure complete customer satisfaction. He had become frustrated with the poor levels of communication and service in the fire industry and realised that complete customer focus was the key to success. Consequently, Mark is actively involved in the personal and professional growth and development of the team, as he believes that people are essential to the success of the business. Both he and the rest of the team will always go that extra mile to ensure that customer requirements are met, first time, every time.

Mark believes the professionalism, trust, and reliability within the AFC Fire team, coupled with a true understanding of our clients’ needs and requirements, is key to the continued success of the business.

Name: Joe Chandler
Bio:
I started working in the fire safety industry in 2018 as a fire systems engineer focusing on the install, maintenance and commissioning of fire alarm systems, emergency lighting and fire extinguisher. A passion for fire safety led me to become a fire risk assessor with AFC Fire and Security. 

My time with AFC has been incredibly rewarding and my continuous development has allowed me to carry out Fire Risk Assessments, Fire door inspections and compartmentation surveys on a range of different properties. 

At the end of 2023 I took on the role of Principal Fire Consultant at AFC. This role has allowed me to pass on my knowledge and training to junior members of the team and also manage some of our large, ongoing projects while also continuing to work as a competent Fire Risk Assessor.

Name: Caden O'Leary
Bio:
I joined AFC Fire in March 2023, at which point I was new to the industry. I wanted to join AFC because I knew that my skills, combined with continued support and guidance from the AFC team, would help me develop into a competent Fire Risk Assessor. 

Despite still being in the early days of my career as a Fire Risk Assessor, I have achieved qualifications and gained lots of experience in delivering suitable and sufficient Fire Risk Assessments, Fire Door Inspections and Compartmentation Surveys. I fully understand the seriousness of my job role, as well as the skills required to meet AFC’s high standard. 

I joined AFC because I want to learn from the best, and work with the best. I fully believe that myself, and the entire AFC team, have the skills, ability and potential to become influential members of the fire safety industry.

Name: James Pratt
Bio:
I began my fire safety career with AFC Fire in August 2022, as a fire door inspector. My AFC colleagues were (and still are) great to work with and encouraged me to move further into fire safety by training to become a fire risk assessor. 

In October 2023 I qualified as a fire risk assessor and began carrying out FRAs. These started with small, residential properties and have now progressed to include larger and more complex premises, both residential and commercial. 

Throughout my journey so far, AFC Fire has provided the support, guidance, and challenges I needed to progress and continue to be one of the best companies I have worked for.

Name: Ethan McNichol
Bio:
I joined AFC fire in September 2024 on an apprenticeship scheme, I had close to no experience or understanding of the fire safety industry, however, with the guidance and support that AFC offer, and have given me, it did not take long for my passion and drive for the Fire safety industry to take hold.

During my time at AFC I have gained a vast amount of knowledge and skill through numerous training courses; practical experience, shadowing, and online CPD. Throughout the time I’ve worked with AFC I have gained the knowledge to become a competent fire door inspector, as well as reaching a level of competence to do compartmentation surveys within buildings. 

I am very happy with the experience I have obtained so far, but the learning doesn’t stop now. In the near future, I aim to accomplish the role of being a competent fire risk assessor and I am dedicated on expanding my understanding and skill capabilities within the industry.
